content: For programmatic SEO at scale in Next.js App Router: don't return every param from generateStaticParams (slow deploys) -- pre-build only high-priority pages (top search-volume combos), leave dynamicParams=true (default) so long-tail pages render on first request and are cached/served statically thereafter (ISR-style). Use per-fetch { next: { revalidate: N } } or route-level export const revalidate = N to keep pages fresh without full rebuilds.
